primary_source.title: TSCG: Deterministic Tool-Schema Compilation for Agentic LLM Deployments
primary_source.author: Furkan Sakizli

claims_checked.claim: At 20 tools Mistral 7B changes from natural 35.0% to conservative 80.0%; at 50 tools 30.0% to 75.3%.
claims_checked.scope: Three runs per cell, n=60 per cell in the paper's Scenario D.

claims_checked.claim: Gemma 3 4B at 50 tools changes from natural 24.3% to conservative 87.5%.
claims_checked.scope: Same benchmark/compiler/model condition; not a general model-capacity estimate.

claims_checked.claim: Tool-schema representation can be a dominant measured factor, so JSON-to-TSCG gains for small models should not automatically be attributed to token compression.
claims_checked.source_detail: The paper reports R^2=0.88 against JSON baselines collapsing to 0.03 against text baselines and explicitly classifies Phi-4, Mistral 7B, Gemma 4B and Qwen3 4B as format-dominated. Against text baselines, their compression gain is reported as -7 to -23 pp in the summary taxonomy rather than a positive compression benefit.
claims_checked.scope: This supports protocol/representation sensitivity in the paper's tested tool-use conditions. It does not show JSON is intrinsically inferior or that compression itself causes the small-model gains.

claims_checked.claim: A single schema profile can regress a model that is already well adapted to the representation.
claims_checked.source_detail: For Qwen3 14B at 20 tools, natural=90.2%, conservative=99.3%, balanced=84.1%; parameter F1 is 98.3% conservative versus 81.0% balanced. The balanced profile is below natural by 8.7/6.1/5.0 pp at 10/20/50 tools.
claims_checked.scope: Supports per-model/version profile regression testing; it does not establish conservative mode as universally optimal.

artifact_provenance.repo_observation: The paper-linked public repository exposes benchmark/, findings/, src/, tests/ and related implementation material; the README describes the tool-schema compiler, benchmark results and current packages.
artifact_provenance.paper_claim: Code, benchmark suite and evaluation logs are linked from arXiv.
artifact_provenance.artifact_scope: Repository availability strengthens traceability, but this audit did not independently replay the approximately 19,000 calls or reconstruct every table cell from raw logs.

statistical_scope.paper_note: The paper reports that 9 of 107 pairwise McNemar tests pass Holm-Bonferroni correction at alpha=0.05.
statistical_scope.interpretation: Do not treat every individual Table 3 difference as independently multiplicity-corrected significant merely because its point estimate is large. The candidate's decision value is primarily the directly controlled representation sensitivity and sign-changing model/profile interactions, not a blanket significance claim for all cells.

verdict.evidence_strength_update: The exact FE-208 headline cells and the representation-confound mechanism are directly supported by the primary paper. Public code/benchmark artifacts exist. Independent end-to-end numerical replay remains outstanding.
verdict.admission_note: This is materially relevant to O whenever tool-use capability is compared across schema encodings: protocol representation and model-specific profile interaction must be held fixed or explicitly ablated before attributing differences to model reasoning/capability. Preserve the paper-specific benchmark/model scope.
